agentComposeDraftDescription: Review the draft here. Open the composer when you are ready to edit or send it.

agentComposeReplyMissingThread: This reply draft is missing the source thread.
agentComposeForwardMissingMessage: This forward draft is missing the source message.
composeEmbedFieldHint: Use the message toolbar for variables, images, and links; use Variables next to the subject for the subject line.
composeAttachmentTooLarge: {{name}} is too large (max 10 MB per file).
syncConnectedMenuHint: Choose which linked inbox is shown here.
settingsDescription: Connect Google or Microsoft mailboxes and review account health.
listDescription: Recent conversations across the selected mailbox.
subject: Subject
recipientFieldPlaceholder: Type an email or name — pick a contact from suggestions or keep typing
templateHelper: Start from a reusable template and adjust it before sending.
noThreadsHint: Try another mailbox or search term.
selectThread: Select a thread to read the conversation.
selectThreadHint: Choose a conversation to see the full thread and actions.
connectGoogleHint: Link a Gmail account via Nylas OAuth.
connectMicrosoftHint: Link an Outlook account via Nylas OAuth.
nylasEwsUnauthorizedReconnectHint: Exchange sign-in was rejected. Check your username and password. If your mailbox uses two-step verification, create an app password in your account security settings and use that password here.
nylasMicrosoftAdminConsentRequired: Microsoft requires tenant admin approval before this Outlook connection can be used. Ask the customer's Microsoft admin to approve the Nylas app, then try again.
nylasMicrosoftConditionalAccessBlocked: Microsoft blocked this Outlook connection through Conditional Access. Ask the customer's Microsoft admin to review the Entra sign-in log and policy result.
nylasMicrosoftAppBlocked: Microsoft blocked the Outlook app connection for this tenant. Ask the customer's Microsoft admin to allow or approve the app before retrying.
nylasMicrosoftTenantMismatch: This Microsoft account does not match the expected tenant. Use the customer's work account or ask their admin to confirm the tenant.
nylasMicrosoftAccessDenied: The Microsoft Outlook connection was cancelled or denied.
nylasMicrosoftOAuthCooldown: Microsoft Outlook connection was attempted recently. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
nylasMicrosoftConnectDisabled: Microsoft Outlook connections are temporarily paused until tenant admin approval is confirmed.
nylasMicrosoftAdminApprovalRequired: Microsoft Outlook connections require customer IT/admin approval before users connect.
microsoftPreflightRiskOutro: . A misconfiguration can freeze accounts and affect other accounts in the organization.
microsoftPreflightAck: I understand the risks and confirm that my admin allows connecting external services and has configured Office 365 accordingly.
sendError: Failed to send email. Please try again.
saveToStorageFailed: Failed to save attachment to storage.
threadLinkedFuneralCaseSuccess: Email thread linked to funeral case.
threadUnlinkedFuneralCaseSuccess: Funeral case link removed from email thread.
funeralCaseAuditDescription: Email conversations linked to this funeral case for audit.
composeTipTemplates: Use templates for faster, more consistent replies.

templateClickRowHint: Click a row for a full preview. Edit from the table or from the preview window.

templateEditorDescription: Plain text or HTML in the message field is sent as provided by your mail provider.

templatesViewAccessDenied: You do not have permission to view email templates in this organization.
templateDeleteDescription: This action cannot be undone. Drafts that referenced this template will keep their content.
templateNotFound: That template is no longer available.
templateEmbedImageIntro: Use a public HTTPS image URL for an inline picture, or upload a file (added as an attachment and noted in the message).
templateEmbedImageUrlHelp: Recipients must load this URL over HTTPS. Private or signed links expire and usually break in email clients.
templateEmbedImageUploadHelp: The file is added to template attachments and a short note is inserted in the message so recipients know an image is included.
templateEmbedImageUploadAdded: Image attached and noted in the message.
templateEmbedImageInsertedNote: Attached image: {{fileName}} — also listed under Attachments.
